static_traits.name: Lin Tao
static_traits.social_status: 有几个可以交谈的朋友，但not yet向他们分享自己对唱歌羞耻的感受；因回避唱歌相关的聚会与活动，社交生活受限，与朋友关系因敏感度提高而趋于紧张

basic_info.main_problem: 我对自己糟糕的唱歌水平感到尴尬和not自信，尤其是在朋友拿这件事开玩笑时。
basic_info.core_demands: Persistent negative thoughts and embarrassment about singing have begun to affect my confidence and overall well-being, so I decided to seek counseling.
growth_experiences: 青少年时期开始因唱歌被同伴嘲笑，最初压力水平中等，但随着时间推移在社交场合愈发突出；为避免再次尴尬和被取笑，逐渐回避唱歌或卡拉OK活动；每当朋友提及自己的唱歌，就会涌现尴尬和低自我价值感；尽管关系受影响，仍有一些朋友愿意与自己一起活动，但自己have not与他们分享这方面的感受。

core_beliefs: 我的价值取决于他人对我的评价

special_situations.event: At a gathering with friends, friends joke about his singing
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果do not人取笑我的唱歌，就说明他们看not起我，我作为一个人也not被认可
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: 回避与唱歌相关的话题与活动，尽量not在社交场合唱歌
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 他们真的觉得我很差劲、看not起我

special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果我唱not好，就一定会出丑并被嘲笑
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Refuses or avoids such invitations, reduces attending gatherings
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: If I go sing, it will definitely be embarrassing and they will laugh at me

special_situations.event: 朋友在谈话中提到他的唱歌水平
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 唱歌not好not仅是技巧问题，也说明我这个人not够好
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Tries to improve his voice by watching tutorials online to reduce the risk of being mocked

special_situations.event: Friends comment on his singing in a light joking manner
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 朋友的玩笑是在针对我这个人、是对我的negate
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Treats jokes as attacks, strengthening self-defense and avoiding discussing this topic with friends
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 他们是在嘲笑我这个人
